name: Baize self-chat data
builder: UC San Diego / Sun Yat-sen University (Baize authors)

release_date.note: arXiv v1 date of the Baize paper.

availability.note: Data lives in the project's GitHub repo, not on Hugging Face; the repo data folder returned HTTP 200. No HF dataset repo id was confirmed (project-baize/baize-chatbot is not a dataset).

content.value: Paper: dialogues produced by having ChatGPT chat with itself ('self-chat') from seed questions from Quora and Stack Overflow; 'we collect a total of 111.5k dialogues through self-chat, using ∼55k questions' for the v1 family. Repo README lists 54K/57K/47K dialogs from Quora, StackOverflow and MedQuAD questions. Falcon-7B/40B-instruct's card lists Baize as part of their fine-tuning mix.
content.note: Counts are the paper's and the README's; the released files were not counted.

record_history.change: created from primary sources (tranche 2 dataset records)
